Adds Fashionpedia pilot conversion, GT validation and a repeatable human review audit. Conflicting selections and disclosed answers remain separate; drafts are never automatically promoted to accepted.

Validated on AutoDL in wkq's isolated Python 3.10 CPU environment: 19 tests, existing contract fixtures, pip check, 20 images, 145 source-identical masks/crops and 218 package file checksums. Shared package: `/root/autodl-tmp/fashion-grounding/shared/processed/fp_pilot20_v2`.

Audit: 32 target agreements, 6 disagreements and 2 disclosed-answer groups. Accepted=0. The 34 category-only and 6 spatial groups are for interface checks; richer language data and human adjudication remain pending. B0, unified model evaluation and actual model consumer validation are not implemented by this change. No GPU training or optional extensions.

See `docs/handoffs/data_eval/remote_pilot_review_20261112.md` for reproduction and evidence. Data, original human reviews and credentials are not committed.

pull_requests.body:
Provides the Fashionpedia eight-class Mask2Former S0 pipeline, reproducible checkpoint selection, fixed candidate exports and lcy's minimal integration with wyz's published B1 ranker. S0 reached u20000; complete dev250 AP selected u18000 (63.5792). The current authorized language dev selected candidate threshold 0.3 by matched coverage before ranking.

### Completed lcy integration

Existing u18000 + 0.3 candidates now connect to the unchanged B1 interface at grounding commit 103dcc5 and return the selected original mask/box. No ranking method or teammate source was changed. Predictions remain schema-3 candidate IDs/scores; a separate derived view resolves original geometry and mask hashes.

On the fixed user-authorized language dev (116 images, 145 bilingual pairs, 290 query records):

| Metric | Result |
| --- | ---: |
| Legal original-mask/box outputs | 290/290; zero inference errors |
| Predicted selection accuracy | 178/290 = 61.3793% |
| Conditional selection accuracy | 178/258 = 68.9922% |
| Matched candidate coverage (reused) | 258/290 = 88.9655% |
| Mean target-mask IoU | 0.700345 |
| Success@0.5 | 212/290 = 73.1034% |

These are B1 integration measurements, not completed M1/M2 research or final-test results. Geometry success and same-class one-to-one selection accuracy are distinct. All original query authorship/review fields remain unchanged; user_authorized_development is explicit. Only the answer-free Query allowlist reaches ranking. GT is loaded after predictions are saved.

The integration evaluator joins the previously saved wkq associations and uses the shared mask_iou function for newly selected masks. It does not rerun matching, change metric definitions, relax wkq's accepted-only entry point, or choose another threshold based on ranking accuracy.

### Validation and bounded execution

- Source 994c1e586989d970a3f41006c301244eda6dbeff; results 977f122. Only three new CPU checks ran (0.005 s): original geometry/cross-image rejection, hand-computed selection versus geometry metrics with failed queries retained, and missing predictions/tampered masks rejected. Old checks and smoke were reused.
- Shared-GPU stage finished in 22.572 s under a 1,200 s hard bound, with no retry or extension. New encoding: 651 regions and 6 texts; 284 text requests reused existing exact-signature features. New features are in lcy's own run; wyz's existing cache is read-only.
- Zero segmentation inference, segmentation checkpoint loads, optimizer updates or old smoke. End state: GPU 0 MiB/0%, no compute process or active lock record. This cached-candidate duration is not first-image end-to-end latency.
- Team branches and all five PRs checked; wkq f5787f4, wyz 103dcc5 and main 7064ebb unchanged. Only lcy's clean checkout advanced; grounding remained clean at its pinned commit.
- Nine lightweight result artifacts were hash-verified after transfer. Queries, images, masks, model weights and features remain on the server.

### Delivery and scope

Server entry: /root/autodl-tmp/fashion-grounding/shared/pipelines/u18000-b1-dev-20261115-r01/delivery_manifest.json. Its run/ link provides predictions.jsonl, resolved_outputs.jsonl, evaluation.json, original inputs and independent features. Preserve symlink targets or copy resolved directories.

Earlier S0, u18000 dev250 candidates, threshold selection and small-object diagnosis remain available. The three threshold packages contain 1,360/1,182/1,032 candidates on 250 images; current 0.3 coverage uses only the 116 language-query images. Neither AP nor candidate inference was rerun here.

The requested lcy integration stage is complete and stopped. Teammate receipt, wyz's B2/M1/M2 development, wkq's cross-method evaluation/demo, train candidate scope, E1 and final test remain separate responsibilities. No additional training is authorized. Keep this PR draft and unmerged.

### Evidence

- [Minimal pipeline, results, paths and scope](https://github.com/rickyliuchunyu/comp4471-fashion-grounding/blob/segmentation/pilot-adapter-v1/docs/handoffs/segmentation/u18000_b1_pipeline_20261115.md)
- [Evaluation](https://github.com/rickyliuchunyu/comp4471-fashion-grounding/blob/segmentation/pilot-adapter-v1/docs/handoffs/segmentation/evidence/u18000_b1_pipeline_20261115/evaluation.json)
- [Completed S0](https://github.com/rickyliuchunyu/comp4471-fashion-grounding/blob/segmentation/pilot-adapter-v1/docs/handoffs/segmentation/s0_recovery20000_20261115.md)
- [Fixed candidate selection](https://github.com/rickyliuchunyu/comp4471-fashion-grounding/blob/segmentation/pilot-adapter-v1/docs/handoffs/segmentation/u18000_language_dev_selection_20261115.md)
- [Team status](https://github.com/rickyliuchunyu/comp4471-fashion-grounding/blob/segmentation/pilot-adapter-v1/docs/status.md)

项目需要统一、可追溯的数据和评价接口，避免试点标签、机器初标与正式测试结果混用。本 PR 汇总 data_eval 的真实数据转换、盲审与修订流程、共享规则解析器、B0 和统一评价核心，并交付版本化的大型数据包。

- 分割数据：5,000 train / 250 dev / 400 held-out test 图。保持官方边界，源 mask 不改写，validation 使用独立 ID 命名空间；哈希、资源地址及含镜像 pHash 保守分组。
- 语言数据：1,000 张训练图、1,580 组中英配对（3,160 条）；dev 116 图、145 组（290 条）。CPU 弱标注加有记录的 Codex 视觉修订，全部保持 needs_revision，新增 accepted 为 0；原小包 17 组 / 34 条 accepted 保留。
- 初标使用保守颜色条件、源纹样和几何；未知属性放弃判断。修订保留原文和证据，35 个按页审核页面不嵌入目标答案。accepted-only 正式评价门禁保持不变。

验证：远端独立 CPU 环境 93 项测试通过；五个包通过 schema/几何/hash 检查、独立 pycocotools 源 mask 逐像素一致性和候选裁剪检查；发布后逐文件 SHA256 核对。分割/训练查询/dev 查询分别视觉抽查 64/64/31 个目标；这不是全量质量认证。无 GPU 使用或模型训练。

限制：机器训练文件只供明确选择弱标注实验的输入；dev 仍有 134 张待补写，所有新增语言待人工审核。最终测试没有生成机器语言答案；新大包消费方验收、人工独立测试描述及三方正式冻结未完成。GT 试点诊断不是正式 dev/test 成绩。

详细路径、数据 hash、验证和下一步：[大型数据交接](https://github.com/rickyliuchunyu/comp4471-fashion-grounding/blob/data-eval/p3-baseline-evaluation/docs/handoffs/data_eval/large_dataset_20261112.md)；[P3 交接](https://github.com/rickyliuchunyu/comp4471-fashion-grounding/blob/data-eval/p3-baseline-evaluation/docs/handoffs/data_eval/p3_reviewed_baseline_20261112.md)。大型图片、标注输出和审核包保留在服务器共享数据盘，不提交 Git。

接入 B 发布的 schema-3 候选、共享查询解析和统一评价器，提供锁定版本的 SigLIP 2 编码、冻结特征缓存、B1/B2 预测与规则覆盖率。新增只读流式数据验收，以及显式 train-only 的 M1 弱标注短试训入口；模型推理仅接收完整查询和候选，不读取人工答案字段。

依赖 #4：本 PR 暂以 data-eval/p3-baseline-evaluation 为 base，只展示 grounding 的改动；请先审核该接口依赖，再按团队流程调整 base。未合并 main。

实际验证：
- B 数据环境的 111 项联合测试通过；grounding 环境的 24 项专项测试通过（18 项接口测试有重叠）。数据构建依赖 NumPy 2，不能把 B 的构建测试直接当作 NumPy 1.26 模型环境测试；环境差异已记录。
- 6 个真实发布包：32,574 个哈希条目、25,715 份候选/COCO/源 mask 比对、逐图解码裁剪、查询引用、跨分区 ID/hash/group 隔离通过；计数含语言子集重复。
- 同一34条 accepted train 查询：B0 12/34（复现），B1 18/34，B2 22/34。B2 lambda=1为事先固定诊断值，未用train选参。完美/空输出/不完整预测等独立评价控制通过；B1/B2纯缓存重放完全一致。
- M1：1000图/3160条机器描述，冻结编码器，seed42固定5轮；同训练弱标签拟合78.07%→83.96%，检查点重放一致。未声称泛化提升；正式dev尚无accepted查询，M2和其他种子未运行。

交接与完整命令：docs/handoffs/grounding/accepted_baselines_and_weak_trial_20261112.md；小型证据索引已提交。数据、权重、缓存、凭据均不在PR内。
